FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
At Fresh Artisan Bagels, we specialize in the production and sale of freshly baked bagels and artisan breads. Our operations involve baking on site, ensuring that all products are made from high-quality, locally sourced ingredients to maintain the highest standards of flavor and freshness. We have implemented documented food safety programs in compliance with health regulations, which includes maintaining proper sanitation and refrigeration controls to prevent spoilage and contamination of food products. 

To enhance our commitment to safety, we have automatic extinguishing systems installed over all cooking equipment. Our establishment is equipped with monitored fire and burglar alarm systems, significantly reducing risks associated with fire and theft. Our staff undergo regular training in food safety practices, and we adhere strictly to health code regulations to ensure compliance. We also prioritize online ordering security by employing robust cybersecurity measures to protect customer data. Operating hours are designed to cater to peak breakfast and lunch sales, providing a reliable source of income throughout the week.

Our bakery prepares a variety of fresh breads and pastries using traditional ovens and cooking equipment, without the installation of automatic extinguishing systems overhead.
